study_question: Do the structural / dealer-positioning states the app records live at decision time (zone, gamma-wall proximity, regime) carry predictive information about the attached outcome labels — as fixed, semantically motivated rules with no fitting?

explicitly_not.not_an_admission_packet: PASS here is NOT evidence for decision-path admission. Admission additionally requires an economic study (entry/exit simulation, costs per cost_model_registry_v1, deflated performance) per AGENTS.md decision-path admission.
explicitly_not.not_training: No parameters are fit. Every rule below is a fixed semantic mapping declared before the run; abstentions are honest (no fabricated direction).
explicitly_not.not_production_wiring: Report-only. No decision-path effect. governance/decision_path_admissions.json is untouched.

data.decision_rows: calibration_decision_log (read-only) — identical row gates to Studies #1/#2 (trusted, RTH, fusion available, outcome attached)
data.structural_fields: zone, regime_primary, nearest_above_dist, nearest_below_dist — recorded live at decision time (pre-outcome by construction)
data.price_bars: price_bars_1m (read-only) for the regime-gated momentum rule — bar_end_ts_utc <= decision_ts_utc, 120s staleness gate (Study #2 join)
data.row_alignment: incumbent rescored on the identical row subset each rule scored — never mismatched denominators

rules.zone_direction: pin_bull -> up; pin_bear -> down; breakout -> up; breakdown -> down; pin_chaos or missing -> abstain. Tests whether the app's own zone classification is directionally informative.
rules.wall_attraction: predict toward the NEARER wall: nearest_above_dist < nearest_below_dist -> up; nearest_below_dist < nearest_above_dist -> down; equal or missing -> abstain. Tests pin-to-the-closest-gamma-wall dynamics.
rules.wall_repulsion: mirror of wall_attraction (toward the FARTHER wall). Symmetry control — at most one of the pair can carry positive signal.
rules.regime_gated_momentum_15: momentum_15 (Study #2 rule) ONLY when regime_primary is trend_continuation, acceleration, or breakout; abstain otherwise. Tests whether regime conditioning rescues momentum.

family.multiple_comparison_scope: Holm-Bonferroni across ALL 48 (ticker x horizon x rule) tests in one declared family

primary_metric.name: MCC (multiclass Matthews correlation, Gorodkin)
advancement_screen_per_test: day-block bootstrap 95% CI of MCC excludes 0 (B=1000, resample ET dates with replacement)
Holm-Bonferroni adjusted bootstrap p < 0.05 across the declared 48-test family
accuracy >= always_flat baseline AND accuracy >= majority_class baseline AND accuracy >= persistence baseline
shuffle control null centered at zero (else STOP: artifact — investigate before any claim)
primary_metric.no_post_hoc_switching: metric, family, rule definitions, gates, and thresholds are frozen by this file before the run

baselines.majority_class: predict the cell's majority truth class
baselines.persistence: predict the previous scored row's truth label (look-ahead-advantaged, deliberately hard bar)
baselines.shuffle_control: truth labels permuted within test (K=200, fixed seed) — must score at chance
baselines.incumbent_reference: the recorded stack dominant_direction rescored on the identical row subset (context metric, not a screen gate)

serial_dependence_honesty.issue: identical to Studies #1/#2 — ~1-minute decision cadence vs (N+1)-minute label spans; rows are not independent trials; structural states persist for many consecutive rows

sample_floors.below_floor_action: test reported as UNDER_SAMPLED; excluded from PASS/FAIL claims

stop_conditions: shuffle control significantly off-center in any test -> STOP (artifact) before interpreting anything else
zero tests meet sample floors -> report INSUFFICIENT_DATA; no claims

outcome_interpretation.test_PASS: the recorded structural state carries real information at that cell — it becomes a candidate for the economic study and a conditioning variable for future model candidates
outcome_interpretation.test_FAIL: that structural rule carries no detectable signal there — narrows the search
outcome_interpretation.wall_pair_note: wall_attraction and wall_repulsion are mirrors; a PASS on one with the other near its negative is coherent physics, both near zero means wall proximity is uninformative

outputs.authoritative: JSON report; console summary is convenience only
